title: a ticket charts itself stage by stage
intention: A ticket charts itself: Ticket.draft(stage, packet) puts a chart stage's draft on the ticket's plan under chart.<stage>, Ticket.berthed(stage, berth) records the berth a gate wrote under the state's chart_berths, and Ticket.chart(participant) queues the ticket at each chart stage in turn (orient, constrain, survey, decompose, triage, hypothesize, validate), stopping at the first stage whose gate does not pass it.
why: Outline 9.6 (Akien 2026-11-10, Q#81): each chart stage and the verdict is a gate machine that answers queueme <fileref>, and the ticket class queues itself to each in turn; 3.3.4.3: the ticket sends only its fileref and its life is data on disk, so the stage's draft must stand on the ticket for the gate to read. Measured 2026-11-11: cairn/machines/ticket/ticket.py has queueme, passed and failed and nothing that holds a chart draft, records a stage's berth or queues at a sequence of gates; the one chart driver is cairn/devices/cc/scripts/chart_ticket.py, which imports CodeMother's seven stage machines.
traces_to: Outline 9.6 and 3.3.4.3 (Q#81 answer); RULE 1 — the chart is reached through CodeMother's gates, not her code.
how: ticket.py gains CHART (the stage order), draft/drafted (the plan's chart), berthed/berth (the state's chart_berths) and chart (queueme at each stage in turn, stop at the first non-pass). The tickets store charter declares chart in plan_fields and chart_berths in state_fields. A red-first proof drives it over a scratch tickets store with a spy participant.

clauses.claim: draft('survey', packet) writes packet under the plan's chart.survey (not the state file), drafted('survey') returns it, and draft('nosuchstage', ...) raises ValueError naming CHART with the plan's bytes unchanged
berthed('orient', a) then berthed('constrain', b) leaves the state's chart_berths equal to {orient: a, constrain: b}, berth('orient') returns a and berth('validate') returns None

chart(spy) whose every reply body says accepted and passed true sends exactly seven requests, to codemother, with verbs machines/orient/queueme through machines/validate/queueme in CHART order, each body exactly {fileref: the plan path}, and returns charted true, stopped_at None and seven stage results

chart(spy) whose third reply (survey) says accepted true and passed false sends exactly three requests, returns charted false and stopped_at 'survey', and a non-accepted reply at orient stops at orient after one request
the live store charter /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/tickets/_charter+why.json lists chart in plan_fields and chart_berths in state_fields

decisions.text: D1: declare chart in plan_fields and chart_berths in state_fields of /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/tickets/_charter+why.json, through the artifact door (cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write, verb cast), appending each to its list.
D2: ticket.py gains module tuple CHART = ('orient', 'constrain', 'survey', 'decompose', 'triage', 'hypothesize', 'validate'); the verdict is not in it (it is queued after the build).

D3: Ticket.draft(stage, packet, *, why) refuses a stage not in CHART with ValueError before any write, else reads the plan's raw JSON, sets doc['chart'][stage] = packet and writes it through ticket_file.rewrite_ticket(plan, doc, why=why, verb='cast'); Ticket.drafted(stage) returns (doc().get('chart') or {}).get(stage).

D4: Ticket.berthed(stage, berth, *, why) refuses a stage not in CHART or 'verdict' with ValueError, else merges {stage: berth} into doc().get('chart_berths') and writes {'chart_berths': merged} through self._write; Ticket.berth(stage) returns (doc().get('chart_berths') or {}).get(stage).

D5: Ticket.chart(*, participant, timeout=30.0, stages=CHART) calls self.queueme(stage, participant=participant, timeout=timeout) for each stage in order; a result passes when queued is true and reply.passed is true; it stops at the first that does not and returns {charted: bool, stopped_at: stage or None, stages: [{stage, queued, passed, reply}]}.

D6: the red-first proof cairn/machines/ticket/proofs/test_a_ticket_charts_itself_stage_by_stage.py builds a scratch tickets store with the live store charter copied in and ticket_file._TICKETS pointed there, one tooth per falsifier clause, binding Ticket inside each tooth (never at import).

measured.saw: Ticket has queueme, passed and failed only; no chart draft, stage berth or sequence; chart_ticket.py imports the seven stage machines
